releaseNotes:
Lint had been non-blocking and 166 errors had piled up. Triaged:

- ShizukuRunner called Process#destroyForcibly() unconditionally; it is API
  26+ and throws NoSuchMethodError (an Error, not an Exception) on Android
  7.x — i.e. a crash on the shell choke point. Guarded with a destroy()
  fallback.
- layout_game_space_panel: android:tint -> app:tint so AppCompat actually
  tints those two icons on older APIs.
- QuickTiles: the pre-34 Intent overload of startActivityAndCollapse is the
  only option there; silenced narrowly with a comment.
- QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES documented at the declaration.
- Stripped a stray BOM from the middle of ShellExecuteFeature.kt.
- StringFormatMatches demoted to warning in lint.xml: %s accepts any object,
  so the flagged calls are legal and intentional; reason recorded.
- CI now fails on new lint errors; report still uploaded.
